\label{lemma-bound-neighbours}
Let $n, m_i, a_{ij}, w_i, g_i$ be a numerical type of genus $g$.
Given $i, j$ with $a_{ij} > 0$ we have
$m_ia_{ij} \leq m_j|a_{jj}|$ and $m_iw_i \leq m_j|a_{jj}|$.
